name: Pizzeria da Bruno
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria da Bruno in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria da Bruno** in the heart of **Tirol**! Here, authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Our freshly baked pizzas, crafted with love, are the perfect start to your culinary adventure in this stunning region.

Indulge in our signature dishes like the **Tiroler Klassiker**—a hearty pizza topped with local **Speck**, crispy **Obatzda**, and a sprinkle of fresh herbs. Or try our **Kaiserschmarrn Pizza**, a sweet and savory twist on the famous Austrian dessert, loaded with caramelized apples, walnuts, and a dusting of powdered sugar.

Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a refreshing **Tiroler Apfelwein** from the region. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or something more adventurous, our menu has it all.

Visit us in **Innsbruck**, **Kitzbühel**, or **Lienz**—each location offers a unique experience with breathtaking mountain views. Come taste the magic of **Tirol** at **Pizzeria da Bruno**!
